semantics.readbackScope: Explicitly selected installation/tenant/root record and immutable captured directory/file identity plus bytes
semantics.rootFile: Unsigned structural declaration of installation label, tenant, key and installation scope
semantics.signatureScope: Existing anchor signatures relative to the declared key; installation label is not part of those signed bytes
semantics.continuation: Same anchor is idempotent but cannot be appended twice; successor is exactly +1 with exact predecessor and unchanged graph/checkpoint/restrictions
semantics.checkpointAndRestrictionChanges: Rejected until independent prefix and retained-history verification is implemented
semantics.highwater: Exact internally consistent full-routes/tail declaration; not an externally protected monotone floor
semantics.fileOpens: Read-only, nofollow/nonblock when supported; helper directory opens also directory-constrained; existing narrow Windows identity bridge unchanged
semantics.initialization: No mkdir, bootstrap, writer, lock, permission repair, recovery or environment override

limitations: No independent installer approval, protected durable routing pin, trusted tenant root, business router or mutation grant is created
The same key/tenant signed packets can be rebound to another unsigned installation label; an explicit test demonstrates the absence of installation-binding signatures
An existing reader rejects changed or rolled-back files; a new process can read a coherent whole-group rollback as locally consistent with all authority flags false
No external witness or state protected from the business caller is present, so cross-process whole-group rollback and deletion/rebuild are not prevented
Ancestry, pathname and descriptor rechecks do not provide openat semantics, a common atomic filesystem snapshot, or protection against arbitrary rename/restore ABA
The genuine ancestor replacement test is between reader calls and keeps the leaf directory inode; the during-read race test replaces a highwater file, not an ancestor
Real directory junction/symlink rejection was exercised; no real Windows file-symlink replacement test is claimed
Mode/uid/gid metadata is compared without native ACL inspection; owner-only permission authority remains false
Windows nonblock/directory flag checks are conditional on platform constants; actual FIFO behavior is independently established only by the WSL probes
WSL probes use actual POSIX FIFOs and the repository child fixture but do not constitute Linux/macOS CLI CI, Strict Sandbox or a release matrix
No authenticated RRSI producer, alias publication protocol, Registry business writer, release source gate, real model/cost experiment or production promotion was enabled
